INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file, rename it, edit params.
Reference in a run file as: sensors/IRST/my_IRST

PARAM_DOCS.frequency_hz: N/A for IR sensors. IRST operates in infrared wavelengths (~3-12 μm), not RF. Not affected by rain but severely degraded by fog and clouds. This field is ignored for IR sensor types.
PARAM_DOCS.fov: 360deg azimuth. Passive sensor — no RF emission.
PARAM_DOCS.pd: 0.7 — depends on thermal contrast. Less affected by rain than radar, but fog is devastating.

name: IR Search and Track
